title: Private Bind Key
description: A holder declares, privately, a P-256 key it controls outside its KEL, so that a reissuer can bind a credential derived from the holder's credential to that key (SD-JWT cnf, mDoc deviceKey). Self-issued: issuer and issuee are the holder AID. Shown only to the reissuer, which verifies it before deriving.
$comment: The private counterpart of bindkey, which is a public announcement by design. This one is targeted, nonced in both slots, compactable, P-256 only, and short-lived (this.i @kakslwv3).

t.description: Message type. Optional; an ACDC JSON message without it is of type acm.

i.description: AID of the holder, which issues this credential to itself

rd.description: SAID of the holder's registry whose TEL carries this credential's issuance and revocation. Required: a binding must be withdrawable the moment the key is lost.

oneOf.description: SAID of the compact attributes block

u.description: Privacy nonce, so an observer who guesses the key cannot confirm the guess by recomputing this block's SAID

i.description: AID of the holder: the issuee, and also the issuer, because this credential is self-issued

dt.description: When the holder made this declaration, as an ISO-8601 datetime

purpose.description: What the key is bound for. Pinned, so the credential cannot be repurposed silently.

pubkey.description: The holder's P-256 public key, encoded as keyFormat says: a JWK object for jwk, a CESR string for cesr.

validFrom.description: When the binding starts, as an ISO-8601 datetime. Absent means it starts on issuance.

validUntil.description: When the binding stops, as an ISO-8601 datetime. Required, because a holder binding is meant to be short-lived; the deriving party enforces the ceiling.

pubkey.description: A public P-256 key as a JSON Web Key (RFC 7517/7518). No private member d is admitted.
A CESR ECDSA secp256r1 verification key: code 1AAJ (transferable) or 1AAI (non-transferable).

oneOf.description: SAID of the compact rules block

privateToTheReissuer.const: The holder shows this credential only to a reissuer it has chosen, so that the reissuer can bind a derived credential to the key. A party that obtains it any other way has no license to rely on it, to retain it, or to link the key to the holder.

bindsForDerivationOnly.const: The holder declares that it controls this key for holder binding in credentials derived from the credential of which it is the issuee. The declaration confers no other authority, and a verifier MUST NOT treat the key as one of the holder's KERI signing keys.

keyNotAssertedSound.const: The holder declares that it controls this key. It does not assert that the key is uncompromised, generated soundly, or held in secure hardware, and a verifier MUST NOT read any of those into this credential.

bindingEndsOnHorizonOrRevocation.const: The binding holds from validFrom, or from issuance when none is stated, until validUntil or revocation, whichever comes first. A reissuer MUST check the registry before deriving, and MUST NOT derive a credential that outlives the binding.
